description: Marketplace fees by type (commission, shipping, reverse shipping, fixed, collection, pick-and-pack) per channel for a period, with rate-card gaps (possible over-charges) only where a rate card exists. Flipkart, Amazon, Meesho, Myntra, JioMart, Ajio; default last 30 days. Pass feeType for one type (faster).

channel.description: Limit to one channel. Default: all connected channels.

feeType.description: One fee type. Default: all main types (one lookup each).

since.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2026-10-01, IST day). For "this month" send the 1st of the current month; for "last month" send its 1st with until = its last day. Default: 30 days ago.

until.description: End date (ISO, inclusive IST day). Default: today.

name: get_fee_breakdown
title: Get fee breakdown
